_doc: 既知の不合格の表（R4 A6）。tools/run_tests.sh は、ここに載っていて期限（expires、YYYY-MM-DD、その日まで有効）の切れていない試験の不合格を FAIL ではなく KNOWN と出し、終了コードに数えない。
1行: {"file": "sim/.../test_x.gd", "reason": "なぜ落ちるか・直す道", "owner": "誰が直すか", "added": "YYYY-MM-DD", "expires": "YYYY-MM-DD"}。期限は長くて2週間。期限が過ぎた行は FAIL に戻る（表に残っていても）。

rows: その行が許す落ちた項目の名前（RESULT の failures の label の最初の語、「line N:」なら「line N」）の並び。2026-10-31 V114 から必須、V115 から名前の完全一致: 落ちた項目の名前が rows に無ければ FAIL、rows が空か2文字未満の名前があれば FAIL、落ちた項目の名前が無いまま終わった（exit 1 で failures が空）なら FAIL（照合は tools/test/known_rows.py、試験は tools/test/test_known_rows.gd）。
直したら行を消す。表に載った試験が合格したら WARN（行を消してよい）と出す。

2026-10-06 A6: test_audio_danger（終わりの漏れ・29.5分）、test_ui_layout・test_ui_cards・test_ui_hud・test_save_roundtrip（ときどきの漏れ）は直した。test_bank・test_traits・test_ai_stability・test_ledger_reconcile は HEAD 43bcdd9 で合格。載せる物は今は無い。

failures.reason: H1s-d (the 65+'s living arrangements at the start, at fc4ef4ff with §10.7 B3's never-married margin: alone 0.192, couple only 0.365, with a child 0.443; rec@4a551b1c read 0.370 / 0.438 against 0.217 / 0.407 / 0.337, +-5 pt) is the start's one outcome check and fails: the old with a child come from two T constructions (adult children of 35+ at 表8's 35-39 rate; the old-householder three-generation form) and, with the alone cells held as margins, the rake finds the old there. Recorded, not raked to (ISS_HOUSEHOLD_REDESIGN.md §10.1); its check is HB1c at year 10. The PM's ruling (2026-10-29 21:15): stays an emergent FAIL. ALSO H1s-m: H1s-m (the start's never-married share by sex and R62 band, drawn since §10.8 C3) cannot meet R62 in 7 of 10 bands even with every one-person adult of the band never married: the start's couples (built from R64's types by householder age) hold more persons of 25-44 than R62's ever-married share allows (e.g. men 30-34 0.448 against 0.518, 28 persons short of 402). Reported as found, as declared: the conflict between R64's couples and R62's statuses, for the PM's call (§10.8 C3).

§12.8 10.2 and §12.9 M005 (M1 pensions by entitlement with M1b survivors and M1c 生活保護, M2 annual cash pay, M4 the 2022 targets): two checks fail and are reported, never fitted (refreshed 2026-10-31 at the T2.2 WIP, V117; T1s-pe now passes). T1s-cm: the fitted top 0.01% line 109.6 M against the tax table's 168.8 M (-35.1%), mean 207.9 M against 508.8 M (-59.1%); suspected cause 合計所得 including separately taxed capital gains (R67a, CHECK). T1s-hi against 国民生活基礎調査 2022's 2021 incomes x1.0199: D1 -23%, D2 -17%, D3 -6%, D4 -5%, D5 -1%, D6 +4%, D7 +7%, D8 +10%, D9 +11%, median +1.1%, mean +6.0%, 3 of 9 deciles beyond 10%; the known causes left: the couples' income link and 生活保護 for couples and larger households are T2's (T2.5), the survey's non-receipt kept by sex x band (M1a withdrawn) at D1

T1s-lp (R85 国勢調査 2020 第49-2表, the share living with a parent by sex x 5-year band x marital, ±5pt T, declared 8f2d9bac) fails: the construction's household composition, not the check (TO_E 11:41); its fix is M016's role margin, and since R77c M021's cohort-consistent marital state (TO_E 17:02 (5)). T1s-bpw, T1s-bpr (§12.15, R77c's 2015 -> 2020 backtest with R88's prefecture split, M020 D20, and each prefecture's own survival (R89 ratios) and leaving (R82), TO_E 17:10; tolerances 4.71 / 3.16%, TO_E 16:58) pass the exceedance share and fail the 2x cap on 3 cells (TO_E 17:02 (1)): pref x wife Hyogo 85+ +10.4%, Tokyo 85+ +10.0%; pref relative Osaka 20-24 -7.5%. The 85+ cells take the nation's 85+ age mix and the national events' survival (T, §12.15); Osaka 20-24 is young couples' migration (M020 D20-4, a known limit, T). R89 and lambda by prefecture brought the other 6 old-age cells inside the cap and T1s-bph to a pass. The cap is not adjusted. T1s-hh0 (V111 (1)): 1,028 lone-parent persons below their type's minimum size and 4,710 couple + children / single-parent households the minimum pass leaves without a child; type 3's persons after the size floor (it moved 281,752 into type 3) against its households, the children too few in those prefecture x band cells (V115 part 2). T1s-hh0 (a) (V113): 1,221 minimum-pass children outside R83's window, all to 85+ mothers of single-parent households; M019 (2)'s structural zero at gap <= 0 with the 85+ top code (V115 part 2). T1s-gap2 (M018): 3 of 4 birth-year groups beyond tolerance (1950-69 0.057 against 0.036 at gap 6; 1990-2009 0.037 against 0.033 at gap 8; 2010-22); the minimum pass's mother-child gaps against M018's comparator, 1950-69 the old mothers in nuclear households (M019's input conflict). T1s-lc (a tripwire): L's type-4 child persons clipped 0.726 M, 13 band cells beyond 0.5%; L's 2020 within-type shares against the type-4 target (an input conflict, M019; M022 reduced it from 0.77 M). None is adjusted. Any other FAIL in this file is a real failure.

T2s-dgb-h (§14.6 (12), V121: a CONSISTENCY row against NIPPON DATA90, a source that shaped the input; not held out) fails for men at T2.2c + M035 (b64e5469): grade 4 (4a and 4b) ÷ grades 1-3 HR over 12.2 years 1.812 against 1.31 (1.00-1.73), |ln| 0.324 against 0.313; women 1.747 against 1.43, in. At T2.2b both were in (men 1.630, women 1.556). Every grade-4 ratio in the file rose by about the same 11-14% for both sexes (the 4 ÷ 3 REPORT 1.086 / 1.065 -> 1.196 / 1.187; the read-back 2.316 -> 2.631), with m_4b = m_4a, so the likely cause is persistence, not the multiplier: 4b (care need) leaves only at e_b 0.0125 against T2.2b's grade-4 stay of 0.525 b / 0.604, and the grade-4 raise to LTCI's prevalence puts more of the 65-90 baseline mass into that persistent state, so the baseline grade-4 group stays at m 5.03 for more of the 12.2 years. Not proven by a run. The FAIL stands; the row and its bound are unchanged and nothing is tuned (the PM, 2026-11-01). T2s-dgb-t (Tosa, held out) passes for both sexes

The frozen oracle's decade CHECK run (b316b6e8, T2.2c + M035 + M036, TO_PM 109): 32 of 36. T2s-dt fails at year 1 only, on 2 of 202 cells (women 70 z -4.25, men 88 z +4.12; all six totals inside 2%); it passes at years 5 and 10. Cause: M036's start transient (every slot fresh at pi(a), so year 1's hazard sits slightly above c's); women 70 is not M036's declared place and cannot be shown cleared at 3.937, since the later bounds widen. NOTE: the entry names the row, so a T2s-dt fail at years 5 or 10 would also read KNOWN. T2s-gp: 1 cell in 120 reads, and the re-grade's IPF residual >= 1e-9 in 12 months, all in year 1 (December 0.144), about 1e-12 from year 2; likely the start's (class, state) rows meeting kernel zeros until every cohort has been re-graded once (not proven). T2s-4b: 4 cells beyond 4.175 in 1,680 reads (not printed which); same mechanism suspected. T2s-gk: gap 1 out (always good 0.775 against R92 0.729, always bad 0.090 against 0.108); gaps 5 and 9 in. Recorded, not tuned; to the mathematician (M037). The PM ruled the freeze with these (TO_E 08:20)

The persons layer at T2.2c + M035 (run on 122462e7; M036 and the save fix do not touch the persons, TO_PM 100): T2s-gp fails, 15 cells beyond 4.581 in 120 reads with the re-grade's IPF residual >= 1e-9 in all 120 months; T2s-4b, 190 cells beyond 4.175; T2s-gk, always bad far below R92 (0.074 / 0.015 / 0.007 against 0.108 / 0.043 / 0.027 at gaps 1, 5, 9). Likely cause (not proven): the persons' pools by age x sex x quartile hold a handful of persons each, so the re-grade's IPF often has no exact solution, misses pi(a) and mixes the bad side back out at each birthday. T2s-dt (persons) passes at years 1, 5 and 10, women drifting up (+5 / +17 / +18% at 65+, inside its sampling bound). Recorded, not tuned; to the mathematician (M037)

By design until T2.3: M026 §3's decisive check (TO_E 23:38 (1)) asks the attenuation of the bottom-to-top death ratio to be under a third in every band from 60-69 up; it reads a worst 48.3% (leave-one-household-out; person-out 36.0%, inclusive 31.7%), so the stop STAYS until T2.3's household income points. A decision row, not a defect; it lapses when T2.3 lands in Python (the PM, TO_PM 113), where it is to be registered year-tagged

I3 (the hit persons' security deficit above their start after the lay-off wave) reads 0 of 3 on the D477 inputs: the 2023-10-01 cohort changes the 60-person draw of seed 7, and the three persons the wave hits end with no deficit above their start. A sample effect of the new cohort, not a rule change; registered by the PM's ruling (after TO_PM 125), not re-seeded.
